findings.builder_claim: studio_bridge._replay sends the whole reply list in one argv; intake_session refuses it (QUESTION_NOT_PRESENTED on a fresh session, ONE_REPLY_AT_A_TIME beyond one new reply); poll returns before the run line, so a new Studio order never writes control/method.json
findings.detail: Code read confirms the builder's map: shared-bridge/studio_bridge.py _replay built one argv carrying every --reply in a single subprocess call; scripts/core/choice_card/intake_card/intake_session.py process() refuses replies on a fresh session (QUESTION_NOT_PRESENTED) and refuses more than one new reply per turn (ONE_REPLY_AT_A_TIME), with a deliberate one-new-answer-per-turn contract plus idempotent prefix replay (INTAKE_REPLAYED / INTAKE_REPLAY_MISMATCH); poll returns the error before printing the run line. Independent reproduction 3/3 (QC2). Attribution unchanged: pre-existing (the bulk call pattern predates this unit; the same failure reproduces against pre-fix factory.py per builder C3 and against this base).
findings.resolution: Fix X1 below. E1c now PASS (QC4/QC5).

findings.builder_claim: purpose default is read from the run directory (factory.py _purpose_flow_for), so every launcher reaching factory.py card inherits it; this is what makes E2 hold
findings.detail: Code read of factory.py _purpose_flow_for confirms the decision surface as described (explicit flag wins; else method.json / studio-order.json / saved PURPOSE answer / run with no progress files -> purpose card; run with recorded progress keeps its card). Blocks [1][2][4][5][6] cover it and all pass.

fixes.what: studio_bridge._replay now drives the card one turn per answer instead of one bulk argv: a no-reply prime turn presents the question, then turn i carries replies[:i+1] (a growing replay prefix) so the session's own replay absorption reduces each turn to exactly one new answer; the sequence starts past the turns the session already journaled (_journaled_turns reads control/intake-session.json events), so a replay interrupted mid-order resumes without re-answering and a shifted list fails closed at the session's INTAKE_REPLAY_MISMATCH. Any refused turn keeps the old fail-closed behavior: REPLAY_FAILED emitted, EXIT error, no run line. New helper _journaled_turns fails closed (REPLAY_SESSION_UNREADABLE) rather than guessing an unknown history.
fixes.test_change_note: test_factory_card_purpose_w3u2.py block [3] was realigned, not weakened: the old 5 checks asserted the bulk refusal path on a VALID reply list (code==error, no method record, answered_count==0), which is exactly the defect E1c forbids -- the test bound to the bug and could not prove the acceptance. The replacement is 9 checks: 5 on the success path (replay accepted, factory.py launcher, control/method.json written, every answer consumed by its own turn, no turn skipped) plus 4 fail-closed checks kept verbatim in strength on a genuinely refused reply ('purple banana', which IC._parse rejects on the pending question): named REPLAY_FAILED, EXIT error, no method record claimed without accepted replies, no answer silently consumed. Total test checks 35 -> 39; blocks [1][2][4][5][6] untouched; no check was removed without an equal-or-stronger replacement.
